QuestInfo.name: There Goes the Gang
QuestInfo.1: #p3000016# says he is going to break up the Heliseum Protector Vanguard. This is too much...they've been around since childhood!
QuestInfo.2: #p3000016# did not change his mind. #p3000016# insists on breaking up the unit and leaving everyone to walk their own paths.

0.0: Kaiser... Is this how you plan on using your power? Joking around with #p3000017#? You disgust me! I'm done with you, and I'm done with the Heliseum Protector Vanguard. It was a worthless group in the end.

yes.0: I'm done here. I have no future here in #m400000000#! I...I want to be more powerful. Strength is all that matters to me!
And I will become more powerful than you.
